title: AI Google Business Profile Ranking for Landscapers 2026

facts.fact: The page states that in 2025, 78% of local searches were influenced by AI-driven personalization; no source is cited for this figure.
facts.quote: In 2025, 78% of local searches were influenced by AI-driven personalization, meaning Google tailors results for every user.

facts.fact: The page claims landscapers using AI-optimized business profiles see twice as many profile views as those using outdated tactics; no source or sample is given.
facts.quote: Landscapers using AI-optimized business profiles are seeing twice as many profile views compared to those sticking with outdated tactics.

facts.fact: The page reports that one unnamed landscaping company saw a 40% drop in Google Business Profile visits after not keeping up with AI signals.
facts.quote: One landscaping company saw a 40% drop in Google Business Profile visits simply because they didn’t keep up with AI signals.

facts.fact: The page states that inconsistent Name, Address, and Phone (NAP) data was behind 45% of all Google Business Profile suspensions in 2025; no source is cited.
facts.quote: Inconsistent NAP data was behind 45% of all Google Business Profile suspensions in 2025.

facts.fact: The page is dated Monday, 8 December 2025 and is titled for 2026.
